title: Blueprint
description: Canonical, engine-agnostic construction spec for one Canonical Asset or one scene-scoped composition of assets. Describes primitives, deterministic operations, and (for scenes) imported-asset references plus camera/timeline choreography, in terms any compatible translator can realize -- per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's 'Mathematics, Language, And Blueprint' and docs/planning/UNIFIED-BLUEPRINT-PIPELINE-PLAN.md sections 2-3. This schema describes the spec only; it does not describe or require any particular execution engine. tools/blueprint_interpreter.py is the current (Blender) translator that consumes this shape -- see that file's module docstring for the translator-side contract. `compiled_spec`, when present, carries a full Studio Chat PrimitiveBuildSpec (scene_plan/components/registry primitives) for the hierarchical/recipe system in tools/oeb_blender/recipes.py; this is a transitional passthrough for spec shapes not yet expressed as native primitives/operations, not a second parallel format -- see UNIFIED-BLUEPRINT-PIPELINE-PLAN.md section 2.

units_per_meter.description: How many Blender units equal one real-world meter. Declares this Blueprint's scale reference for relative-edit operations to convert against; does not affect primitive construction itself. Defaults to Blender's native 1 unit = 1 meter convention when absent.

compiled_spec.description: Transitional passthrough: a full Studio Chat PrimitiveBuildSpec (scene_plan/components/registry primitives), routed to the hierarchical/recipe system instead of the native primitives/operations vocabulary above. Mutually exclusive with `primitives` in practice -- a translator consuming this field builds geometry from it instead of from `primitives`.

id.description: "camera" is reserved -- the interpreter always creates and registers a camera object under this id before applying operations; do not use it for a geometry primitive.

material.description: Ignored for type=import -- an imported asset keeps its own materials.

canonical_id.description: Required when type=import: references an existing Canonical Asset by canonical_id, resolved against oeb.config.json's assets map.

op.description: The full ontology vocabulary (bisect, loft, sweep, boolean, extrude) is deliberately deferred; added one operation at a time as an actual need surfaces -- see tools/blueprint_interpreter.py's module docstring.

target.description: A primitive id, or "camera" for the three camera/timeline operations.

params.description: Operation-specific parameters -- see tools/blueprint_interpreter.py's OPERATIONS dispatch table and per-op _apply_<op> functions for the authoritative parameter contract of each op.
